description:
When I opened my eyes, I was back in the past 23 years ago?! The brother who killed my parents. Missing my parents, Woo-Joo cried until he fell asleep, and when I opened my eyes, I found myself in the past 23 years ago, before I was even born. Woo-Joo was faced with the other side of his parents, whom he thought were affectionate, and the truth about his brother who had no choice but to become a murderer. Woo-Joo struggles in the face of cold, merciless violence and tries to change the past, but humans do not change so easily. Can Woo-Joo stop the violence of the past and save his parents? What can we do in the face of violence?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)
